name: N87 small-signal permittivity and conductivity (Guillod, APEC 2024)

evidence.description: MIT-licensed dataset of the APEC 2024 paper.
Impedance measurement of an I14/1.5/5 core at 25 degC, peak electric field below 0.05 V/mm.

provenance.normalization: MATLAB data.mat variables read with scipy.io (float64, unmodified); degC -> K; electric field and conductivity in the SI units used by the authors' solver (code prints 1e-3*E as V/mm; sigma enters the complex permittivity with epsilon_0).

columns.name: eps_real
columns.definition: real part of the relative permittivity

columns.name: conductivity
columns.definition: real conductivity (loss term of the complex permittivity)
